verdict.rationale: Poke's own docs show it can generate some artifacts: tables and charts that visualize data, plus websites it creates and deploys at yourname.poke.com. That is a thin, glancing match to creating files. Nothing shows document or presentation creation, iterative editing, or export. missing for 10: document creation, presentation/slide creation, iterative editing workflow, file export formats/download, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export

citations.quote: Poke can now create tables and charts to help you visualize data.
Poke can also create and deploy websites for you at yourname.poke.com.
